newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Natl Mortgage Bank says 96 profit up 80 pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Natl Mortgage Bank says 96 profit up 80 pct.

text.p: State National Mortgage Bank said its fiscal 1996 pretax profit rose 80 percent to 36.1 billion drachmas from 20.0 billion in 1995.
The bank's board will propose to the upcoming annual shareholders meeting a dividend per share of 900 drachmas, up 100 percent on 1995.

In addition, the board will also propose a bonus share distribution -- one bonus per 10 shares outstanding -- resulting from the capitalisation of reserves and gains from the revaluation of fixed assets.
The bank's equity capital rose to 75 billion drachmas from 57 billion in 1995, it said.

Provisions reached 7.5 billion drachmas against 2.1 billion which would have been the case if 1995 accounting principles had been followed, it said. Total provisions rose to 28.1 billion from 20.8 billion drachmas.
"In 1996 National Mortgage saw its turnover rise, helped by the launch of new mortgage products and its foray in new services," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
